gates.evidence: The proposal targets s21 (Favorite messages), which is a standard SFW feature in Luzia.
The reward is 24-hour access to favorite message saving obtained by playing a 15-second game; no clicks, installs, or cash-like rewards are incentivized.
The offer copy uses clean gain/fallback framing without dark patterns or confirmshaming.
The user must tap the CTA button Play Now to opt in.
The body clearly states the action and reward before the ad.
The decline button is No Thanks, which returns the user to the screen without penalty.
The trigger occurs after dismissing the account signup wall on the Favorite messages screen, not during a streaming response.
Eligibility specifies guest users who dismiss the account signup wall.

scores.evidence: Triggered immediately after dismissing the account signup wall on the Favorite messages screen, offering a 24-hour sample of favorite message saving.
Provides a time-boxed sample with clear decline, but violates the rule that account-only features requiring account access cannot be granted via ads.
Gated to guest users who decline signup, time-boxed to 24 hours, and capped at 1 per day.
Cost to serve is zero and US view earnings are within economic viability.
Triggered on s21 (Favorite messages), a frequent guest wall moment.
Uses SIM-RWD unit and standard config, though patch references an unknown resource.
Cites screen s21, resource r2, moment m5, and character Luzia.
Caps per day at 1 with a 60-minute cooldown.
Includes primary metric, guardrails, and a 5% user-level holdout for 30 days.

requiredChanges: Change the reward from granting access to an account-locked feature (saving messages) to a non-account feature or separate bonus quota, as account-only features cannot be bypassed by ads per procedure rule 8.
Fix the patch resource delta to use an existing or correctly defined resource instead of the unknown TemporaryFavoriteAccess.
parsed.topConcern: An ad cannot stand in for account creation; account-only features like saving messages require account access (r2) and cannot be granted via rewarded ads.
